title: Roles & onboarding
tipSub: For PuG servers: version and class roles, PuG categories visible only to the matching version role, two onboarding questions. Only the button writes to Discord. Full admins only.
offline: The bot is not connected to Discord right now. The overview comes back once it is online again.
noPug: This server has no PuG category: a raid category everyone may sign up for (no raider role, no roster).
otherCategories: Not affected (with raider role or roster): {names}

prereq.community: The server is not a community. Onboarding only exists after that (Server Settings › Enable Community).
prereq.manageRoles: The bot lacks the “Manage Roles” permission.
prereq.manageGuild: The bot lacks the “Manage Server” permission.
prereq.roleOrder: These roles are above the bot role: {roles}. Drag the bot role above them in Discord.
prereq.categoryAccess: The bot may not change the permissions in these categories (View Channel and Manage Roles missing): {categories}.
prereq.selfAssign: These roles unlock more than their purpose and must not be handed out by the onboarding: {roles}. Rename them in Discord or take their permissions away.

fallbackNote: No game version is set for {names}; they get the default version and its role. If that is wrong, set the version in the category settings.
noneSelected: No category is switched on. Switch on at least one to apply.
visibleChannels: These channels have their own permissions and stay visible to everyone: {names}. Use “Sync with category” in Discord if they should be hidden too.
changed: Changed in the meantime – please reload.

privileged.pugVersion: is the version role of another version

onboardingError: The onboarding could not be read ({error}). Applying is blocked so nothing gets overwritten.
onboardingOff: Onboarding is still off in Discord. Turn it on in Discord after applying (Server Settings › Onboarding); Discord needs at least 7 default channels for that.
categoryWant: only @{role}, the orga and the bot see it

preview.title: What changes in Discord
preview.lostWarn: Discord replaces the onboarding as a whole: questions and answers that do not come from the bot are lost.
preview.onboardingStays: Turning onboarding on or off and its default channels stay as they are in Discord.
